# OPT4SMART/ros2-vicon-receiver

External reference repository for a ROS 2 Vicon receiver driver.

- URL: https://github.com/OPT4SMART/ros2-vicon-receiver
- Relevance: direct Vicon ground-truth source reference for the experiments in this repository.
- Status: reference only; not vendored into the main project source tree.

This reference is included to document the ROS 2 integration approach used for Vicon ground-truth acquisition and evaluation.
